model.state: all three completed 0.1s SE2 q components; not instantaneous body velocity
model.zero_input: phi(0)=0; zero q and zero command stay zero
model.memory: full 3x3 matrix; after one solve per axis require spectral radius(A)<1; otherwise save HELD, no clipping/retry
model.knot_status: same exposed-data engineering knots .1/.2 as v3; not measured deadzone boundaries
model.action_domain: unchanged full [-1,1] x [-.4,.4] x [-1,1], no command filtering/compensation
model.fit: ordinary weighted one-step least squares, same equal-cohort/case/row weights; no rollout-gradient optimizer
model.limitation: extra terms and full-rank support do not guarantee observable Markov state, low-speed consistency, long-horizon accuracy or unseen-command coverage

data.role: previously exposed exploratory identification only, not independent unknown/final data
data.original_recovery_protocol: HELD remains HELD; only separately verified complete saved cases reused
data.sample_unit: whole trace/case; correlated ticks are not independent repetitions
data.navigation_initial_q: unknown pre-window q: exclude first fitting pair; zero only for diagnostic free prediction
data.probe_initial_q: actual warmup 180/200 endpoints; include first measurement transition
data.partial_interval: exclude incomplete fitting pairs, retain all physics ticks in free prediction

folds.navigation: leave one whole map level out, all six repeated/method cases together
folds.objective: 0.5 navigation cohort + 0.5 controlled cohort; equal traces within each cohort, equal rows within trace
folds.solves: exactly one ordinary weighted least squares per fold/axis, rcond=1e-12; at most nine

diagnostics.free_prediction: align initial pose/q once, then only fixed model and saved actual commands; no truth correction
diagnostics.baselines: reuse pinned v3 verified rows containing same-fold saved affine and ideal-command metrics; additionally report v3 candidate metrics; no baseline fitting
diagnostics.saved: 9 axis solutions/spectra, 3 full-memory stability checks, 30 case arrays/metrics/5-45s prefixes and old affine/ideal/v3 baselines; one-step fit and free-prediction results distinguished
diagnostics.fit_stop: rank<11, condition>1e8, nonfinite, or full-memory spectral radius>=1: save HELD and stop; no coefficient clipping/retry
candidate_checks: Same unchanged response-v3 diagnostic_gate with all original five machine checks; no relaxed M01 tolerance or deleted failed cases
diagnostics.pass_meaning: screening diagnostic only; not new alpha/delta, 90s applicability, navigation success, NAV043 or G5

support.status: SVD-only rank11/11 in each of 3 training design matrices, condition90.21-126.26; real coefficient solves0
support.finding: old five command features have rank4 on exposed navigation; hinge=vx-.1*gate identically, gate=1
support.limitation: This is not v3 full design rank failure: probe rows give old full matrix rank6. Redundancy over navigation commands alone does not establish unique error cause.

once_only.refusal: missing exact APPROVED/readiness, changed pins, existing output or lock before data fit/marker

next_dependencies: Main-agent saved-output audit with zero extra coefficient fit; classify execution and diagnostic results separately
No deployment selection or all-data fit; if screening passes, separately design motion-state/support and independent 90-second residual scope
Executable reference command program and frozen power J evaluation, not length/time rescaling
Affected nominal environment, learning, deployment and physical applicability gates before NAV-043/G5
